title: 穿拖鞋的凌晨一點
subject: a woman who locks herself out in pyjamas and slippers while taking out the rubbish at 1 a.m., and the locksmith who arrives in a dinosaur-print jacket and opens the door in eleven seconds
caption: Mandarin speed garage, late-1990s London style. A pitched-up wobbling reese bassline, shuffled 4x4 kick with skippy offbeat hi-hats, short house organ stabs, a bright whistle-like synth riff on the hook. Chunky club low end, bright sidechained mix. Female alto, punchy rhythmic delivery, half-spoken verses and a belted chorus. 132 BPM, G minor. Frantic, cheeky and euphoric. No trap, no autotune, no dubstep drop, no pop ballad section, no two-step broken beat.
lyrics:
[Intro - organ stabs, shuffled 4x4 kick, wobbling bass]

[Verse 1]
凌晨一點去倒垃圾
睡衣配一雙拖鞋
風一吹 門一關
鑰匙在裡面看我

[Pre-Chorus]
手機也在裡面
我只剩一袋垃圾

[Chorus]
穿拖鞋的凌晨一點
我在樓梯間跳來跳去
誰來開門 誰來開門
我付錢 我付錢

[Verse 2]
跟警衛借了電話
鎖匠穿著恐龍外套
蹲下來 轉兩下
十一秒 門就開了

[Pre-Chorus]
他說小姐別擔心
上禮拜還有人穿浴巾

[Chorus]
穿拖鞋的凌晨一點
我在客廳跳來跳去
門開了 門開了
垃圾還沒有倒

[Outro - whistle synth riff, bass wobble fades]
